We’d be glad to help, and I’m sorry it feels a bit uncertain choosing a gift.

Here are a few helpful options:

Shop in person: Use our Store Locator to find nearby retailers so they can try styles and sizes on.
Shop online: Browse our full selection at blundstone.com, where we offer product reviews and True Fit (“Find My Size”) on product pages to help choose the right size.
Size help: Use the True Fit tool on any product page to get a personalized size recommendation based on the recipient’s usual shoe brands and sizes.
Out-of-stock gifts: If a style/size is sold out, you can use the “Notify Me” button on the product page to get an email when it’s back.
Payment methods: We accept Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Discover, and PayPal, and credit cards are charged immediately.

Using these tools should make it easier to pick a pair of Blundstones that will fit and be enjoyed as a gift.
